full_name: Tamar Herzog | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2015–2016 History Radcliffe Alumnae Professor Harvard University
bio: Tamar Herzog’s work centers on the relationship between Spain, Portugal, and Portuguese and Spanish America and the ways by which Iberian societies changed as a result of their involvement in a colonial project.
